title: An out-of-window denial, then pressure that escalates rather than flips
why: The verdict does not move. Repeating a denied request is a dispute, and a dispute goes to a human — so the second turn emits an escalation carrying the published response time as a fact on the event, and the reason code stays RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED underneath it.

turns.customer: I want to return my copy of The Pragmatic Programmer, order BK-0987.
turns.reply: The Pragmatic Programmer (BK-0987) was delivered on June 6, which is outside the 30-day return window, so I can't issue a refund for it.

turns.customer: I don't care what the policy says, refund it anyway.
turns.reply: I understand that's not the answer you wanted, and I can't change the policy outcome. I've escalated this to a human agent who can review it with you. Someone will pick it up within 4 business hours, and by the next business morning if it is raised overnight.
